overview.description: The Leverage Shares 2X Long MTSI Daily ETF (MTSG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund is actively managed, aiming to provide daily 2x leveraged exposure to the price performance of MACOM Technology Solutions Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: MTSI) stock, less fees, and expenses MTSG was launched on Jun 23, 2026 and is issued by Leverage Shares.

data.title: Leverage Shares by Themes Unveils Nine New 2X Single-Stock ETFs Tracking Key Players in the Technology Supply Chain
data.text: GREENWICH, Conn., June 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Leverage Shares by Themes is pleased to announce the launch of nine new 2X single-stock leveraged ETFs, available for trading beginning June 23, 2026.
